bale.definition:
n. a large bundle bound for storage or transport
v. make into a bale
bale.translation:
n. 包, 捆, 货物, 灾难
vt. 打包, 捆包

bale out.translation: v. 用降落伞降落; 跳伞

baleares.translation: n. 巴利阿里（西班牙一省）

balearic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the isles of Majorca, Minorca, Ivica,
   etc., in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of Valencia.
balearic.translation: n. 巴利阿里群岛；巴利阿里迪斯科（迪斯科乐曲）

balearic islands.translation: 巴利阿里群岛（西班牙东部）

balearics.definition:
plural of Balearic
a. Of or pertaining to the isles of Majorca, Minorca, Ivica,
   etc., in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of Valencia.
balearics.translation: (Balearic 的复数) n. 巴利阿里群岛；巴利阿里迪斯科（迪斯科乐曲）

baled.translation:
vt. 将某物打成包或包装成捆
n. 大包, 大捆；货物
n. (Bale)人名；(斐)姆巴莱；(塞)巴莱；(英)贝尔

baleen.definition: n a horny material from the upper jaws of certain whales; used as the ribs of fans or as stays in corsets

balefire.definition: n a large outdoor fire that is lighted as a signal or in celebration
balefire.translation: n. 野外大火, 烽火, 焚化尸体的火

baleful.definition:
s. deadly or sinister
s. threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments
baleful.translation: a. 有害的, 恶意的

balefulness.definition: n. The quality or state of being baleful.

baleri.translation: [医] 贝娄病(锥虫病的一种)

bales.translation:
n. （货物）包, 捆( bale的名词复数 )

balestra.translation: 击剑时冲刺后朝对方的一跃
